question: Esgaroth Garrison enters and its recruit trigger starts resolving. I draw my card and look at my hand, then I want to decide what to discard. Can my opponent cast an instant after seeing my draw but before I discard and possibly create the Human Soldier token?

expected.shortAnswer: No: once the recruit ability begins to resolve, nobody can act until the draw, the discard and any token creation are all done.
expected.answer: Once a spell or ability that causes you to recruit begins to resolve, no player may take any other actions until it's done. Any responses made to the spell or ability must be made before you draw, discard, and potentially create a token.

whyHard: Players treat the draw, the discard and the token as three separate steps with a window to respond between them, but recruit resolves as one uninterrupted action.
